title: Cosmo: the edit rank decides, not the edit notes
description: Fabio 2026-10-24: Cosmo started an edit on Klein 9B, then Qwen Edit, past Qwen-Image 2.1 (rank 1) and FLUX.3 Klein (rank 2), though all fit his PC. The list_models notes let a note that matches the ask beat the rank: Klein 9B sells keeping the likeness, Qwen-Image 2.1 leads with its non-commercial licence, FLUX.3 reads as a many-pictures specialist, and the Boogu note names a fallback order without FLUX.3. Rewrite the edit notes so the rank decides; pin with a test.
